method: Actual Three camera, world/instance matrices, geometry, core raycast/fire, actual app pointer/keyboard/minimap draw calls. WebGLRenderer mocked; tests use east/right, north/up, physical projected turns and observed draw calls, not old yaw-sign expectations.
limitations: No browser, GPU culling image or phone measurements
Native lighting appearance not judged; matrix-space placement tested

checks.name: Six spawn markers and five building centers preserve east/right in overview
Default north-facing gameplay shows west spawn/gate on left and east on right
Instance transforms retain semantic forward direction for player, enemy and tank
Left shoulder remains left across yaw, pitch, aiming and rotated layouts
Physical right-turn gesture turns camera and minimap clockwise together
Right strafe is screen-right at every yaw and east at north heading
Keyboard right-turn agrees with camera and north-up minimap
Aim converts center ray to core, fire hits target, and core wall occludes
Death effect follows reflected world and expires without orphan scene node
Bunker camera and hidden player retain correct coordinate frame
Environment, entity batches, effects and lights share reflected root; only world is scene child
checks.note: Bundled Three renderBufferDirect tests matrixWorld.determinant()<0 to select reversed front-face for meshes; instance matrices themselves remain positive.
